note: Standard sources for the run. At env_check, a screener subagent checks each one (reachable? license? bulk download or API?), sets status to ok / partial / unreachable with a one-line note, and logs it. Never bypass paywalls or robots rules. Database and screen data are pre-cutoff, so they feed tier 3, the knowledge base and the discovery engine, never tier 2. Record source_type on every extracted row.

sources.name: EPA CompTox / ToxCast zebrafish developmental screens (Tanguay lab and others)

sources.name: Planarian high-throughput chemical screens (e.g. Collins/Hagstrom lab ToxCast-library work)
sources.holds: regeneration and morphology endpoints for hundreds of chemicals in planaria

sources.name: Zebrafish fin regeneration and drug screen literature

sources.why: a third regenerating organism for the cross-species test
